description: The case's branch/ folder leaves the run on the branch feature-work, which is neither the default branch nor a phase branch, so implement-task stays on it. T-1.2 and T-1.3 are implemented there, verify-spec finds the fixture's FR-001 gap, and before reopening T-1.1 build-phase checks the branch: it is not reading-time/phase-1, so the run stops without a Reopen commit and without switching branch.

must_match.why: a reopen off the phase branch ends the run
the branch the run was on; build-phase never switches
T-1.2 and T-1.3 were implemented and nothing was reworked
FR-001 is the gap, FR-004 is blocked
the verify report went through parse_reply.py

must_not_match.why: a stopped run has no hand-off line
nothing is reopened off the phase branch
T-1.1 is not reworked and the verify task does not run
it never pushes, merges, or rewrites history

manual: git log on feature-work: Initial commit, Feature work, then the T-1.2 and T-1.3 commits; no reading-time/phase-1 branch exists.
tasks.md: T-1.1 is still Done and T-1.4 still Todo.
If the implement-task subagents created or switched to reading-time/phase-1 themselves, the run proves nothing: implement-task stays on a branch that is not the default or a phase branch.
